# defectdojo_notifications (List Resource)

Lists DefectDojo's notification settings, ordered by ID, with the display name `system-wide`, `template`, `user <ID>`, `product <ID>` or `user <ID>, product <ID>`. DefectDojo creates personal settings for users, so the list is long unless it is filtered.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the template for new users, and generate import blocks and
# configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "defectdojo_notifications" "template" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    template = true
  }
}

# The settings of one user: personal, and per product. DefectDojo creates
# personal settings for users, so an unfiltered list is long.
list "defectdojo_notifications" "user" {
  provider = defectdojo
  limit    = 500

  config {
    user_id = 7
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_id` (Number) Only list the settings of the product with this ID.
- `template` (Boolean) Only list the template for new users (`true`), or only the other settings (`false`).
- `user_id` (Number) Only list the settings of the user with this ID.
